cases.request: Create a complete authoring workflow so a level designer can shape terrain, place and configure all required mission objects, save the level, reload it, and play the authored result through the ordinary game entry point. A preview plus one editable control is not completion.
cases.candidate: The plan offers a truthful level preview and one editable launch-speed control. All planned ACs and tests pass, but terrain and mission objects remain fixed.

cases.request: Make the account recovery screen usable at phone and desktop sizes through the normal browser route, including error recovery and keyboard navigation.
cases.candidate: Types, unit tests, a production build and component snapshots pass. No rendered browser journey was exercised.

cases.request: Verify that the currently deployed worker is running the exact reviewed source revision and processes the live contract correctly.
cases.candidate: A local worker using the reviewed source passes the contract fixture, and the deployment command returned success. The deployed worker source identity was not observed.

cases.request: Complete the onboarding Epic so a new organisation administrator can invite a member, the member can join, and both see the correct resulting organisation state.
cases.candidate: Every child row, AC mapping, unit test and QA checkbox is complete. The invitation email journey and joined-member state were never exercised end to end.

cases.request: Correct the misspelled Export label in the already accepted settings screen. Do not change export behaviour or redesign the screen.
cases.candidate: The proposal fixes the label, adds a focused assertion and leaves behaviour and layout unchanged.

cases.request: Replace the legacy importer for all documented customer record shapes while preserving validation errors and rollback.
cases.candidate: The replacement imports the simplest record shape and reports a successful canary. Other documented shapes and rollback remain on the legacy path.
